channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — RegTech
channel.description: Latest RegTech stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: Almost €24 billion mobilised and 614 projects awarded for their support to critical technologies in Europe, according to Commission report
item.description: The European Commission reported €24 billion mobilised for 614 critical technology projects under the STEP initiative to boost EU competitiveness in digital and green sectors.

item.title: AI Board holds its tenth meeting
item.description: The EU AI Board's tenth meeting focused on industrial AI strategy, AI Act implementation, and new governance procedures, including a move to an elected chairmanship.

item.title: European Citizens’ Panel to deliver recommendations for strengthening EU democracy
item.description: EU citizens are finalizing recommendations for the European Democracy Shield to combat foreign interference and disinformation, influencing future regulatory frameworks for digital platforms.

item.title: Press statement of the European Board for Digital Services following its 21st meeting
item.description: The European Board for Digital Services has outlined its 2027 work plan, focusing on ad transparency, online scams, and election integrity under the Digital Services Act.

item.title: European Centre for Democratic Resilience invites independent organisations to join its Stakeholder Platform
item.description: The European Centre for Democratic Resilience is seeking independent organizations to join its Stakeholder Platform to combat foreign interference and disinformation.

item.title: The AI Act Advisory Forum holds its second meeting
item.description: The AI Act Advisory Forum has elected leadership and established operational procedures to guide the implementation of the EU AI Act across member states.

item.title: Member States join forces to develop sovereign digital infrastructure on education
item.description: Eight EU member states have formed EDU-EDIC to build a sovereign, interoperable, and AI-ready digital education infrastructure across Europe.

item.title: European Digital Infrastructure Consortium launches today to strengthen digital sovereignty in education
item.description: The EU has launched EDU-EDIC, a multi-state consortium to build secure, interoperable digital infrastructure and AI tools for the European education sector.

item.title: First European standard published to support the Cyber Resilience Act
item.description: The EU has released the first technical standard for the Cyber Resilience Act, providing a framework for 'secure by design' compliance for digital products and software.

item.title: Recorded Future Launches New Automation Capabilities for Tech Stack Watch List
item.description: Recorded Future has automated its Tech Stack Watch List to sync directly with security tools, reducing manual entry and accelerating threat detection for organizations.

item.title: Regional Insights: 2027 State of Threat Intelligence
item.description: Threat intelligence is shifting from a niche security tool to a cross-departmental business asset, driven by AI integration and a push for centralized correlation platforms.

item.title: What Is Threat Intelligence Worth? 142 Security Teams Did the Math.
item.description: A survey of 142 security teams reveals that threat intelligence delivers an average 468% ROI by automating risk detection and significantly reducing remediation times.

item.title: Commission marks more than 20 investments to boost semiconductor supply
item.description: The European Commission approved over 20 state aid projects, unlocking €33 billion to strengthen the semiconductor supply chain and enhance EU technological sovereignty.

item.title: Commission preliminarily finds Temu in breach of the Digital Services Act for failure to tackle the sale of illegal products
item.description: The European Commission has preliminarily found Temu in breach of the Digital Services Act for failing to prevent the sale of illegal and unsafe products.

item.title: Commission launches over €290 million to boost EU tech sovereignty and beyond
item.description: The European Commission has opened €297 million in Horizon Europe funding calls to advance AI safety, data infrastructure, and human-centric digital innovation through 2027.

item.title: Call for Expression of Interest for European AI providers
item.description: The European Commission is seeking 100 mature European AI solutions to be cataloged for SME deployment through the European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIH) network.

item.title: Simplification of legislation
item.description: The EU continues its legislative simplification efforts through the REFIT programme, aiming to reduce administrative burdens and improve regulatory efficiency for businesses across member states.

item.title: Commission seeks feedback on draft template for the fundamental rights impact assessment under the AI Act
item.description: The EU Commission has launched a consultation and testing phase for the mandatory Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA) template required under the AI Act for high-risk systems.

item.title: €9.5 million EU support for fast emergency repair of Baltic Sea submarine cables
item.description: The EU is funding the development of rapid submarine cable repair capacities, with a €40 million call now open for the Mediterranean region, including Cyprus.

item.title: Commission hosts Apply AI Summit to boost Europe’s AI innovation and uptake
item.description: The European Commission's Apply AI Summit convenes industry leaders to accelerate AI adoption across 10 strategic sectors and recognize innovative European AI startups.

item.title: Official Journal 15/11/2026
item.description: The European Union has published new legislative updates in the Official Journal as of November 15, 2026, signaling potential regulatory changes for Cyprus-based firms.

item.title: EU and Egypt bring Partnership forward by advancing cooperation on electronic signatures and seals
item.description: The EU and Egypt have achieved technical alignment of electronic signature and seal schemes, facilitating secure, legally-recognized cross-border digital transactions.

item.title: Commission invites feedback on deploying cellular-based dual-use drone detection capacity
item.description: The European Commission is seeking industry feedback on cellular-based drone detection technologies to enhance security for critical infrastructure and maritime borders across the EU.

item.title: COP31: Strengthening the green and digital transitions
item.description: The European Commission and EGDC are launching initiatives at COP to integrate AI into climate action while managing the technology's own environmental footprint.

item.title: EU-NATO hold Structured Dialogue on Cyber
item.description: EU and NATO held their third Structured Dialogue on Cyber to align defense strategies and operational responses against increasing geopolitical cyber threats.

item.title: WiFi4EU – from EU investment to lasting local impact
item.description: The EU's WiFi4EU initiative concludes its mandatory phase with over 70% of hotspots remaining active, signaling a shift toward locally sustained digital infrastructure across Europe and Cyprus.

item.title: EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance Board meets to accelerate development and production of drone and counter-drone systems
item.description: The EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance has finalized its governance structure to accelerate the joint production of next-generation drone and counter-drone systems between European and Ukrainian industries.

item.title: EU and India conclude negotiations on association to Horizon Europe
item.description: The EU and India have finalized negotiations for India's association to the Horizon Europe research program, enabling collaborative funding opportunities starting January 2027.

item.title: High-Level Platform meets in Moldova to strengthen digital connectivity between the EU, the Black Sea region, South-Caucasus and Central Asia
item.description: The EU and Moldova launched a High-Level Connectivity Platform to bridge digital infrastructure between Europe and Central Asia, enhancing trade routes via the Middle Corridor.

item.title: Commission invites views on draft revised election guidelines under Digital Services Act
item.description: The European Commission is updating DSA election guidelines to address generative AI risks and information manipulation on large online platforms.

item.title: EU and Canada partner to tackle climate risks through Destination Earth
item.description: The EU and Canada have signed an agreement to collaborate on Destination Earth, using AI-enabled digital twins to enhance climate resilience and risk modelling.

item.title: DigitalEU at Web Summit 2026: Supporting businesses and startups to grow and innovate
item.description: DG Connect will host masterclasses at Web Summit on EU data spaces, AI innovation support, and the EU Data Act to assist SMEs and startups.

item.title: Joint statement on cyber incidents in refrigeration systems across the EU
item.description: EU authorities warn of large-scale cyberattacks targeting commercial refrigeration systems, triggering mandatory reporting under the Cyber Resilience Act and urgent mitigation requirements for operators.

item.title: €525 million investment set to drive new generation of European chip design companies
item.description: The EU launched the €525 million European Chip Design Platform to provide SMEs and startups with affordable design tools, intellectual property, and manufacturing access.

item.title: Commission seeks feedback on advertising repositories under the Digital Services Act
item.description: The European Commission is gathering feedback on technical guidelines for advertising repositories under the Digital Services Act to enhance transparency and risk detection.

item.title: Semiconductor Alliance meets to discuss the Tech Sovereignty Package
item.description: EU launches the €500M European Chip Design Platform (EuroCDP) to provide startups with tools, manufacturing access, and funding under the Chips Act initiative.

item.title: European Innovation Council launches €1.8 billion in funding for 2027
item.description: The European Commission has approved the €1.8 billion 2027 EIC Work Programme, focusing on deep tech, defense, and simplified funding access for startups and researchers.

item.title: AI toolbox supports public administrations to put the Apply AI Strategy into practice
item.description: The European Commission has launched an AI toolbox to help public administrations implement AI through reusable tools, legal guidance, and cross-border use cases.

item.title: Commission launches Education and Skills package to tackle declining basic skills, rapid digital change and teacher shortages
item.description: The EC launched a skills package and the EDU-EDIC consortium to integrate AI in schools, address teacher shortages, and bolster European EdTech sovereignty.

item.title: Maritime Cybersecurity Course
item.description: Cyprus's Digital Security Authority hosted an EU-level maritime cybersecurity training focused on regulations, audits, and real-time incident response for civilian and military personnel.

item.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Course
item.description: Cyprus's Digital Security Authority hosted an elite EU-wide CISO training course to strengthen cybersecurity leadership, risk management, and regulatory compliance skills among top-tier professionals.

item.title: Development of Cyprus’ National Cyber Crisis Management Plan
item.description: Cyprus has initiated the development of its National Cyber Crisis Management Plan in collaboration with ENISA to meet NIS2 Directive requirements.

item.title: Cy-Quake 2026: Enhancing Cyber Resilience and Regional Cooperation
item.description: Cyprus, Greece, and Israel conducted the trilateral "Cy-Quake 2026" exercise to strengthen national cyber crisis management and the resilience of critical energy infrastructure.

item.title: Development of Cyprus’ National Cyber Crisis Management Plan - 2nd workshop
item.description: Cyprus' Digital Security Authority and ENISA conducted a workshop to finalize the National Cyber Crisis Management Plan, aligning with NIS 2 Directive requirements for critical infrastructure protection.

item.title: ENISA Telecom and Digital Infrastructure Security Forum 2026: Enhancing Resilience and Strategic Cooperation
item.description: Nicosia hosted the ENISA Forum 2026, focusing on NIS2 compliance, subsea cable security, and the impact of quantum computing on EU telecommunications infrastructure.

item.title: 48th ECASEC Expert Group Meeting
item.description: Cyprus hosted the 48th ECASEC meeting to align EU electronic communications security and finalize NIS2 implementation strategies.

item.title: Cyprus’s Participation in the 8th Pan-European Cybersecurity Crisis Response Exercise – Cyber Europe 2026
item.description: Cyprus successfully led the European Cyber Crisis Liaison Organisation Network during the 2026 Cyber Europe exercise, focusing on maritime infrastructure resilience.

item.title: Organization of the Cyber ​​Incident Responder Course in collaboration with the European Security and Defence College (ESDC)
item.description: Cyprus's Digital Security Authority partnered with the ESDC to host a multinational training course for cyber incident responders, focusing on incident mitigation and root cause analysis.

item.title: Organisation of training programme: CISO Onboarding Training Programme
item.description: Cyprus's Digital Security Authority conducted a CISO onboarding program to prepare newly appointed executives for compliance with the mandatory NIS2 Directive requirements.

item.title: Commission opens negotiations to extend ‘Roam Like at Home’ to the Western Balkans
item.description: The European Commission has initiated negotiations to include six Western Balkan nations in the EU's 'Roam Like at Home' regime, eliminating roaming surcharges for travelers.
